name: Egesheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egesheim (a white net and a yellow star on red).
history: Municipal flag of Egesheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Egesheim arms — net and star on red
